arxiv-2112-13791.title: Amplification of optical Schrödinger cat states with implementation protocol based on frequency comb
arxiv-2112-13791.creator: Hongbin Song, Guofeng Zhang, Xiaoqiang Wang, Hidehiro Yonezawa, Kaiquan Fan
arxiv-2112-13791.description: Abstract We proposed and analyzed a scheme to generate large-size Schrödinger cat states based on linear operations of Fock states and squeezed vacuum states and conditional measurements. By conducting conditional measurements via photon number detectors, two unbalanced Schrödinger kitten states combined by a beam splitter can be amplified to a large-size cat state with the same parity.

arxiv-2305-01145.title: ADVISE: AI-accelerated Design of Evidence Synthesis for Global Development
arxiv-2305-01145.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . When designing evidence-based policies and programs, decision-makers must distill key information from a vast and rapidly growing literature base. Identifying relevant literature from raw search results is time and resource intensive, and is often done by manual screening. In this study, we develop an AI agent based on a bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) model and incorporate it into a human team designing an evidence synthesis product for global development.

arxiv-2305-05848.title: Dual Intent Enhanced Graph Neural Network for Session-based New Item Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2023; May 1–5, 2023; Austin, TX, USA Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2023 (WWW ’23), May 1–5, 2023, Austin, TX, USA Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3543507.3583526 IS
arxiv-2305-05848.creator: Di Jin, Luzhi Wang, Yizhen Zheng, Guojie Song, Fei Jiang, Xiang Li, Wei Lin, Shirui Pan
arxiv-2305-05848.description: Abstract . Recommender systems are essential to various fields, e.g., e-commerce, e-learning, and streaming media. At present, graph neural networks (GNNs) for session-based recommendations normally can only recommend items existing in users’ historical sessions. As a result, these GNNs have difficulty recommending items that users have never interacted with (new items), which leads to a phenomenon of information cocoon.

arxiv-2308-05755.creator: Arkadiusz Nowacki, Ewelina Kołpa, Mateusz Szychiewicz, Konrad Ciecierski
arxiv-2308-05755.description: Abstract Deep brain stimulation (DBS) is a neurosurgical procedure successfully used to treat conditions such as Parkinson’s disease. Electrostimulation, carried out by implanting electrodes into an identified focus in the brain, makes it possible to reduce the symptoms of the disease significantly.

arxiv-2406-14419.title: Spin Statistics and Surgeries of Topological Solitons in QCD Matter in Magnetic Field
arxiv-2406-14419.creator: Yuki Amari, Muneto Nitta, and Ryo Yokokura
arxiv-2406-14419.description: Abstract The ground state of QCD with two flavors (up and down quarks) at finite baryon density in sufficiently strong magnetic field is in a form of either a chiral soliton lattice(CSL), an array of solitons stacked along the magnetic field, or a domain-wall Skyrmion phase in which Skyrmions are spontaneously created on top of the CSL.

arxiv-2406-17696.title: Schrödinger cats coupled with cavities losses: the effect of finite and structured reservoirs.
arxiv-2406-17696.creator: J. Lira, L. Sanz
arxiv-2406-17696.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by J. Lira, L. Sanz. We discuss the generation of a Schrödinger cat in a nanocavity created by the coupling of an electromagnetic mode with an exciton in a quantum dot considering the dispersive limit of the Jaynes-Cummings model. More than the generation itself, we focus on the effects of the environment over the bosonic state in the nanocavity, which has losses simulated by coupling with two different kind of reservoirs.

arxiv-2501-06274.creator: Wentao Xu, Wenlu Fan, Shiqian Lu, Tenghao Li, Bin Wang
arxiv-2501-06274.description: Abstract The rise of misinformation and fake news in online political discourse poses significant challenges to democratic processes and public engagement. While debunking efforts aim to counteract misinformation and foster fact-based dialogue, these discussions are often marred by language toxicity and emotional polarization.

arxiv-2503-19966.title: Unveiling Bifurcated Blue Straggler Sequences in NGC 2173: Insights from Binary Evolution
arxiv-2503-19966.creator: Li Wang (王莉), Dengkai Jiang (姜登凯), Chengyuan Li (李程远), Licai Deng (邓李才), Antonino P. Milone, Long Wang (王龙)
arxiv-2503-19966.description: Abstract Identifying bifurcated blue straggler (BS) sequences in color-magnitude diagrams (CMDs) of star clusters has long been regarded as a powerful diagnostic for distinguishing different BS formation mechanisms. While such bifurcations are typically associated with core-collapsed clusters, their detection in dynamically young clusters raises new questions about their origins.

britannica-1911-chupatty.title: Chupatty (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-chupatty.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-chupatty.description: Article 'Chupatty' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 6), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The word represents the Hindustani chapati, and is applied to the usual form of native bread, the staple food of upper India. The chupatty is generally made of coarse wheaten flour, patted flat with the hand, and baked upon a griddle. In the troubled times that preceded the mutiny of 1857 chupatties were circulated from village to village throughout India, apparently as a token of discontent.

pmc-10691148.title: CSE triggers ferroptosis via SIRT4-mediated GNPAT deacetylation in the pathogenesis of COPD
pmc-10691148.creator: Congping Li, Fei Chen, Liangfen Lin, Jiwei Li, Yamei Zheng, Qingyun Chen
pmc-10691148.description: BackgroundIt is now understood that ferroptosis plays a significant role in the progression of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) induced by cigarette smoke extract (CSE). However, the mechanisms underlying this relationship remain largely unclear.MethodsIn this study, we established a COPD mouse model through exposure to cigarette smoke particulates, followed by H&E staining, analysis of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, and immunohistochemistry assay.

pmc-11315047.title: Can a Novel Light Weight Minimal Support Lifting Exoskeleton Modify Lifting Movement in People without Low Back Pain?
pmc-11315047.creator: Tamer Burjawi, Rifai Chai, Matthew Arrowsmith, Adrian Pranata
pmc-11315047.description: Low back pain (LBP) is a major contributor to lifting-related disabilities. To minimize the risk of back pain, emerging technologies known as lifting exoskeletons were designed to optimize lifting movements. However, it is currently unknown whether a minimally supportive exoskeleton can alter the lifting movement in people without LBP.

pmc-11387916.title: Framework Development for Reducing Attrition in Digital Dietary Interventions: Systematic Review and Thematic Synthesis
pmc-11387916.creator: Jian Wang, Jinli Mahe, Yujia Huo, Weiyuan Huang, Xinru Liu, Yang Zhao, Junjie Huang, Feng Shi, Zhihui Li, Dou Jiang, Yilong Li, Garon Perceval, Lindu Zhao, Lin Zhang
pmc-11387916.description: BackgroundDietary behaviors significantly influence health outcomes across populations. Unhealthy diets are linked to serious diseases and substantial economic burdens, contributing to approximately 11 million deaths and significant disability-adjusted life years annually. Digital dietary interventions offer accessible solutions to improve dietary behaviors. However, attrition, defined as participant dropout before intervention completion, is a major challenge, with rates as high as 75%-99%.

pmc-11482662.title: Enhancing bridge damage detection with Mamba-Enhanced HRNet for semantic segmentation
pmc-11482662.creator: Jie Liu, Deyuan Li, Xin Xu
pmc-11482662.description: With the acceleration of urbanization, bridges, as crucial infrastructure, their structural health and stability are paramount to public safety. This paper proposes Mamba-Enhanced HRNet for bridge damage detection. Mamba-Enhanced HRNet integrates the advantages of HRNet’s multi-resolution parallel design and VMamba’s visual state space model.

pmc-11659888.title: Structural Evidence for DUF512 as a Radical S-Adenosylmethionine Cobalamin-Binding Domain
pmc-11659888.creator: Bo Wang, Amy E. Solinski, Matthew I. Radle, Olivia M. Peduzzi, Hayley L. Knox, Jiayuan Cui, Ravi K. Maurya, Neela H. Yennawar, Squire J. Booker
pmc-11659888.description: Cobalamin (Cbl)-dependent radical S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) enzymes constitute a large subclass of radical SAM (RS) enzymes that use Cbl to catalyze various types of reactions, the most common of which are methylations. Most Cbl-dependent RS enzymes contain an N-terminal Rossmann fold that aids Cbl binding.

pmc-12448986.title: S2DB-mmWave YOLOv8n: Multi-object detection for millimeter-wave radar using YOLOv8n with optimized multi-scale features
pmc-12448986.creator: Mengqi Yuan, Yajing Yuan, Xiangqun Zhang, Zhenghao Zhu, Chenxi Zhao, Xiangqian Gao, Genyuan Du, Nattapol Aunsri, Nattapol Aunsri, Nattapol Aunsri
pmc-12448986.description: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar has become an important research direction in the field of object detection because of its characteristics of all-time, low cost, strong privacy and not affected by harsh weather conditions. Therefore, the research on millimeter wave radar object detection is of great practical significance for applications in the field of intelligent security and transportation.

pmc-12557952.title: Efficacy of Diet on Quality of life in Multiple Sclerosis (EDQ-MS): a study protocol for a randomized controlled clinical trial
pmc-12557952.creator: Farnoosh Shemirani, Anna M. Klein, Allison R. Groux, Rachael Kilpatrick, Lisa Brooks, Mary A. Ehlinger, Warren G. Darling, Vincent A. Magnotta, Christine M. Gill, Karin F. Hoth, Ashutosh Mangalam, Patrick Ten Eyck, Arturo S. Martinez, Jordan Hook, Tyler J. Titcomb, Linda G. Snetselaar, Terry L. Wahl
pmc-12557952.description: BackgroundThe primary objective of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of two dietary interventions, time-restricted olive oil-based (TROO) ketogenic and modified Paleolithic elimination (MPE), compared to usual care control group receiving Dietary Guidelines for Americans (DGA) resources, on quality of life (QoL) among individuals with relapsing–remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS).

pmc-12737093.title: A Control Method for Optimizing the Spectral Ratio Characteristics of LED Lighting to Provide Color Rendering Performance Comparable to Natural Light
pmc-12737093.creator: Seung-Teak Oh, Ji-Young Lee, Jae-Hyun Lim
pmc-12737093.description: Light-emitting diode or LED lighting often faces challenges with color rendering due to its unique spectral characteristics compared to natural light. While efforts to enhance the color rendering index (CRI) have typically focused on improving light source elements, there has been less attention on optimizing the software aspects, such as the combination of light sources and spectral composition.

pmc-13119641.title: Advances in Polymer Film and Coating Technologies for Enhanced Surface Functionality
pmc-13119641.creator: Rashid Dallaev
pmc-13119641.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Polymer films and coatings play an increasingly critical role in extending material functionality across industrial, biomedical, and environmental applications. Recent advances in surface engineering have enabled precise control of interfacial properties, leading to enhanced durability, cleanliness, and protection. This review summarizes state-of-the-art strategies for modifying polymer surfaces, with an emphasis on plasma-based surface modification and plasma-induced polymerization as versatile, solvent-free methods for tailoring wettability, chemical functionality, and adhesion.

pmc-13362304.title: Operationalizing Quality Measurement in Long-Term Care: A Policy Review and Phased Implementation Framework for Greece
pmc-13362304.creator: Maria Gamvrouli, Christos Triantafyllou, Joao Breda
pmc-13362304.description: Background/Objectives: Long-term care (LTC) is becoming a strategic priority for health systems facing population ageing, multimorbidity, frailty, and increasing demand for coordinated medical and social support. Greece faces these pressures in a context of fragmented governance, limited formal LTC capacity, heavy reliance on family care, and quality oversight that remains largely compliance-oriented rather than performance-oriented.

pmc-13449650.title: Identification of serpin B12 as an endogenous inhibitor of epidermal mesotrypsin and its possible role in epidermal desquamation during differentiation
pmc-13449650.creator: Masashi Miyai, Mami Yamamoto, Akira Motoyama, Junichiro Hiruma, Yuko Matsumoto, Yukiko Matsunaga, Makiko Goto, Ryoji Tsuboi
pmc-13449650.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The maintenance of stratum corneum homeostasis requires precise regulation of protease activity, particularly within the desquamation pathway. In this study, we identified serpin B12 as an inhibitor of mesotrypsin in stratum corneum extracts obtained from hyperkeratotic heel skin. liquid chromatography coupled with electrospray ionization tandem mass spectrometry analysis identified serpin B12 as one of the most abundant candidates with known mesotrypsin-inhibitory potential, and recombinant serpin B12 suppressed mesotrypsin activity in a dose-dependent manner.
